name: Aftershoot
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Aftershoot, run local duplicate detection and transparent culling heuristics over a photo folder. The hard boundary is proprietary culling and editing models, photographer training data, speed, and workflow, plus image pipeline quality, models, and workflow polish.
